items.title: How Chevron Is Maintaining Prominence in the Permian Basin
items.summary: With nearly 2 million acres and an interest in one out of every five wells in the Permian Basin, Chevron has recently reached a production plateau and turned its focus to increasing reliability and efficiency in its West Texas operations. On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, CFO Eimear Bonner shows Annmarie Hordern some of the facilities and technologies that contribute to the company's competitive advantage in the region.

items.title: Patience Is Paying Off for Chevron in Venezuela
items.summary: Chevron has been operating in Venezuela since 1923, and remained in the country while many US energy companies left. CFO Eimear Bonner and CEO Mike Wirth discuss the new terms of Chevron's joint venture that's projected to double production in Venezuela over the next five years. They speak to Annmarie Hordern on "Chief Future Officer."
